'''Sev Tok''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Kurost sector/Legends|Kurost sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
The [[Planet/Legends|world]] was plagued by [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and its inhabitants were aided by the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]] around the time [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] served as [[Senator/Legends|Senator]].<ref name="TOEPS1">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />
